metadata.title: मेरा खानदान आदिवासी के लिए लड़ा है और लड़ेगा । महेश भाई वसावा । BTP Leader Maheshbhai Vasava
metadata.description:
Maheshbhai Vasava is the President of the Bharatiya Tribal Party, which claims to represent the interests of the indigenous population of the country. The party has a strong presence in Gujarat and Rajasthan, and in Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh as well.
